title: Phase 2 Train: discovery, kinetic chain map, workout, rep density
area: Train (Phase 2): exercise_discovery, connectivity_map (Kinetic Chain), workout_tracker, rep_density_history

keyFacts.fact: MUSCLES[k].ex gives each of the 23 muscles exactly 3 [name, dose] pairs. That is 69 entries and 66 distinct names: Dips, Push-up plus and Romanian deadlift each appear twice.

MX is a per-muscle guide, not an exercise table. Its fields are act (an animation key), life, bones, team (synergist keys with no weights), nerve, strong, weak, fact, lv (3 gym progression levels as [name,dose], picked by pickEx), cues, mistakes, stretch [[name,dose,how]], mob [name,dose], rest and sign.

EQX gives each muscle a [dumbbells-at-home, bodyweight] pair (35 distinct names). Home vs gym is only implied by which table a name sits in, plus BW_EX and the kit regex in trSessionFor. No exercise carries an equipment tag.

Distinct exercises: 83 training names (MUSCLES.ex ∪ MX.lv ∪ EQX), plus 22 stretches and 21 mobility drills, for 124 distinct (2 overlap). Training moves by RDT_GROUPS: Chest 11, Back 14, Shoulders 16, Arms 13, Legs 20, Glutes 8, Core 10 (mobility: 6/8/5/6/11/4/5). erectors sits in both Back and Core. Eight names are listed under two muscles: Dips, Push-up plus, Landmine press, Prone Y-raise, Band pull-apart, Inverted row, Romanian deadlift and Single-leg RDL. These counts come from evaluating the tables read-only.

SEC maps a name to an array of secondary muscle keys, with no weights. Its 66 keys are exactly the MUSCLES.ex names (13 have none). The 17 MX.lv/EQX names have no SEC entry, so mkItem gives them sec:[]: Incline push-ups, Dumbbell bench press, Weighted dips, Seated dumbbell overhead press, Lean-away lateral raise, Cable pushdown, Glute bridge, Goblet squat, Pike push-up, Prone T-raise, Backpack curl, Overhead dumbbell extension, Bench dips, Dead bug, Dumbbell shrug, Inverted row, Single-leg glute bridge.

Secondary weighting is flat and inconsistent today:
- loadOf counts secondaries at 0.4 of the primary.
- finishWorkout RP load uses n×1.2 for the primary and n×0.4 for each secondary.
- quickLog has its own rule: round(4×(1−s/125)) plus 0.4.
- The session chips (trTargets) use 0.5.
- The body glow uses .45.
The Kinetic chain percentages need Phase 1 to make these one table.
RP rule: gain = min(100−s, max(load≥1?1:0, round(load×(1−s/125)))). rkGainPer estimates 3 sets at about +3 to +4 for low scores. '+45 RP potential' is about 10× anything the rules produce.

No exercise has a classification field. Only rough guesses exist:
- COMPOUND regex, used only for rep ranges in doseFor.
- HOLD regex.
- BW_EX and LOADABLE_BW sets.
- moveFor(name), which maps a name to an animation move and misfires: Incline dumbbell press→'still', Pike push-up→press_chest, Wall-sit calf raise→squat.
- PUSH/PULL, which are muscle lists, not exercise tags.
- it.mob flags on session items.
There is no joint-action, angle or zone data. 'Incline' only exists inside names.

Neglect rules:
- stateOf says 'fading' at daysSince≥7 (not new).
- The visual fade (fadeOf) only starts at 10 days and is full at 21.
- Existing copy: 'Neglected · not trained for N days'.
- The whisper already offers 'Add to today' for the most-neglected muscle. It does S.extra[today].push(k), and sessionForDay1 then adds MUSCLES[k].ex[0] to today's session.
- Dares use ≥21 days.
A logged session in S.workouts is only {d,title,mins,sets,vol}, capped at 90. It stores no exercises or muscles. The demo leaves workouts:[] while S.lifts is seeded.

A lift entry is S.lifts[name] = [{d, sets:[...], rir?}], capped at 20 per name. Each set's shape depends on the kind: load {kg,r}; bodyweight {kg:0 or added,r}; time {s}; carry {kg}; tick {}. rir comes from the effort check. S.log is [{d, m:{muscle:load}, h:{muscle:ts}}], kept for 60 days. No muscles are stored on lift entries.
There is no workout-history list. S.workouts is only read for counts, the streak, week dots and 'Done' lines.

REGIONS maps 9 regions to muscles and has no sub-zones (decided 2026-10-04). The 3D mask is per muscle: startDemo, demoMask and glowShot are all indexed by GLORDER. So 'upper chest' cannot be lit on the model without a shader change, even though pec_major is built from 2 parts.
Body.glowShot(map,yaw) renders our own body, lit by a {muscle:intensity} map, to a PNG. Workout complete already uses it. Panels are opaque, so the live 3D body cannot show behind one.
The Insights panel (openInsights) shows the primary plus 3 secondary chips, without percentages. trPrimaryOf only searches MUSCLES.ex, so an MX.lv or EQX name opened without an item shows no muscles.

The Train hub list has three rows: Muscle ranks, Build my plan and Train something else. Ways to add an exercise already exist: Edit's 'Add an exercise' by group, the whisper's 'Add to today', and the dare's 'Start now' (a one-exercise session).
Any panel with class 'panel u-own' is closed on a tab tap by the closePanels wrapper. All panels share z-index 7 and stack in DOM order.

changes.change:
New file, data plus a few helpers.
- EXI[name]={k,t,kit,p} for all 124 movements.
- KC_JOB: one plain 'job in a lift' line per muscle (23), written from MUSCLES[k].what, e.g. triceps 'Straightens the elbow'.
- KC_JOB_EX: about 10 per-lift overrides, e.g. RDL: forearms 'Holds the bar', erectors 'Keeps your back flat'.
- ZONES and EXZONE: pec_major upper/middle/lower, triceps long head/other, biceps long head/other, hamstrings hinge/curl.
- Helpers: exAll(kit); exInfo(name); exPrimary(name) (EXI.k, then MUSCLES.ex, then MX.lv, then EQX); exSearch(q), reusing norm() (web/ossa.html:5769) and drawResults' exact/startsWith/includes scoring over names, primary muscle names and MUSCLES aliases (5770-5787).
Add `/*@include ui/exdata.js*/` after line 11878 (after train.js). This is the only edit to ossa.html.
trPrimaryOf (line 72) calls exPrimary, so Insights finds a primary for MX.lv/EQX names such as Goblet squat.
New check, run by hand. It reads only and prints any name in MUSCLES.ex, MX.lv, EQX, stretch or mob that lacks an EXI tag or a Phase 1 secondary-weight row.

risks: Some tags are judgement calls: Pallof press, Farmer's carry, Push-up plus, Rack pull, Dead hang (a stretch and a lift). Andrej should skim them.

8 names are listed under two muscles, so each needs one canonical primary. That can differ from the primary inside a session (RDL is under erectors in the plan, but discovery would file it under hamstrings).
Exercise names are the join key for S.lifts, S.swaps, S.myDay and S.dayOrder. Tags must match the strings exactly, and no name may be renamed.
Leave the COMPOUND regex as it is, so doseFor's rep ranges don't shift for existing plans.
designDeviations: Nothing visible on its own. This is the data the three new screens read. The pattern tag (p) is also what Phase 5 Specialization (30-day volume by movement type) needs.
items.showAtEnd: One rendered table of all 124 movements: group, type, home/gym, pattern, primary, and secondaries with %. The 6 or so judgement calls are highlighted for a yes/no.

openQuestions.question: Can I add a type tag (Compound / Isolation / Mobility) to all 124 movements for the filter chips?

Muscle split only (front/side/rear delts and so on)

openQuestions.question: Plain jobs or technical joint actions on Kinetic chain rows?

openQuestions.question: What should the new screens be called?

Ship the S.workouts[i].ex capture early, ideally inside Phase 1's finishWorkout edit, so real history builds up before 2e. It also helps Phase 4's recovery nudge ('muscles you just trained').
